messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx rate for inference-hosted-api in us-west-2. pager sent to #oncall, bridge created -> https://bridge.redwood/xyz :rotating_light:

maria: acked. I’m oncall. jumping into logs and dashboard now.

aj: on standby, can help with routing changes if needed.

maria: initial look — 5xxs seem correlated with KV-cache evictions on the cache-manager side. lots of small short-lived models causing cache pressure. seen a big spike starting 08:42 UTC.

sam: customer impact? any errors surfaced to external callers?

maria: yes — error-rate peaked ~12% for text-generation, some streaming requests aborted. CS already flagged two customers via support.

lina: adding context: dedicated pools in us-west-2 hit OOMs on some pods, autoscaler didn’t add capacity fast enough.

incident-bot: Bridge update: #incident-1998887776 created, runbook link: https://playbooks/redwood/cache-thrash. Handoff notes: legacy routing fallback available.

maria: mitigation actions: 1) scale down model-sharding to reduce per-model KV footprint 2) enable regional fallback to smaller-quantized variant for high-latency requests 3) increase cache-size limit on affected hosts. Applying 1 now.

aj: I can flip routing to route new requests to fallback models. Will do safe canary for 2 mins.

aj: /deploy-routing --target fallback --canary 5%

maria: flipping cache-size to +25% on nodes (kube patch).

maria: cache resize rolled out to 60% of nodes. evictions falling, 5xx down to ~4%

isaac: good catch. I’m going to temporarily lower pager sensitivity so we don’t noise the rotation while we stabilize. propose: suppress low-severity cache-eviction alerts for 15m, keep 5xx >= 5% still paged. Thoughts?

lina: ok with suppress for 15m but record as action item to fix root cause.

product-ops: flagged impacted customers (org-349, org-921). Will send interim note: we mitigated, followup postmortem.

maria: 5xx now baseline ~1.2%. traffic routed to fallback for ~12% of requests during canary, no downstream errors. taking system to recovery.

aj: can we add a quick alert tweak? current alert fires on any increase in cache-eviction-count. We need to only page when eviction_count > X AND 5xx_rate > Y or error_budget_burn > Z.

maria: agreed. quick patch to alert rules:
```
alert: InferenceHostHighErrorBudgetBurn
expr: sum(rate(api_5xx[5m])) by (cluster) > 0.05 and sum(rate(cache_evictions[5m])) by (cluster) > 100
for: 2m
severity: page
```

isaac: adding followups: 1) postmortem session tomorrow 10:00 UTC (maria, aj, lina, isaac, sam) 2) action item tracker created in the incident board 3) runbook update for cache-thrash scenario.

maria: scheduling ok. please add owner for each action. I’ll own the runbook update.

lina: I’ll own autoscaler tuning item — adjust scaling thresholds and add preemptive scale when model churn spikes.

aj: I’ll own routing policy change + canary automation so fallback can be enabled automatically when eviction signals > threshold.

sam: I’ll run an eval to measure quantized fallback quality for the top 5 prompt archetypes and report regressions.

product-ops: postmortem invite sent to stakeholders; will include CS notes and customer-impact timeline.

maria: summary for postmortem: root cause = KV-cache thrash due to high short-lived model churn + autoscaler not responsive enough -> led to OOMs and 5xx. Mitigations applied: cache resize, canary fallback routing, short suppression for noisey eviction alert. Action items and owners assigned.

isaac: monitoring/alerting improvements to put on roadmap: - create composite alert that combines eviction signal + 5xx / error_budget - add adaptive severity mapping based on error budget burn-rate - implement dedupe windows and rate caps on non-actionable infra alerts - surface per-customer error-rate so we can triage high-impact tenants faster

maria: agree. also add: track commit that added the model-sharding behavior causing churn; we should gate default sharding with a gradual rollout flag.

aj: noted. I’ll open PRs for alert-rule changes and the automated fallback canary today.

lina: I’ll schedule autoscaler tuning & load test for model-churn scenarios next week.

incident-bot: REMINDER: postmortem scheduled 1998951600 (tomorrow 10:00 UTC). Please complete preliminary notes in the incident doc: https://incidents/1998887776/doc

maria: closing bridge once followups are in tracker. thanks everyone for quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
